## Technical and Integration Challenges

Most small businesses do not have a dedicated IT team capable of handling API integration, XML schema compliance, or cryptographic certificate management. Phase 2 requires Saudi businesses to connect their ERP or accounting software to the Fatoora platform and submit structured XML invoices carrying a QR code and cryptographic stamp in real time or near real time.
